description: Food-related HUD improvements for Minecraft (AppleCore without the core)

releases.notes:
Added Fabric and NeoForge versions for Minecraft 26.1

NeoForge versions only:
- Fix HUD overlay elements not being hidden properly while mounted (saturation, restored hunger/saturation, restored health)
- Fix the config option `showFoodValuesHudOverlay` not properly hiding saturation restored by held food

Fabric versions only:
- Fix homepage URL in mod metadata file (https://github.com/squeek502/AppleSkin/pull/403)
- Add Chinese translation of AppleSkin for the mod config screen (https://github.com/squeek502/AppleSkin/pull/411)

**Update June 15, 2026**

- Added v3.0.10 for Fabric and Minecraft 26.1.2
  + Fixed compatibility with RoughlyEnoughItems (REI)
  + Added Vietnamese translation (thanks @break08)

**Update June 18, 2026**

- Added v3.0.10 for Fabric/NeoForge and Minecraft 26.2

**Update September 17, 2026**

- Added v3.0.10 for Fabric/NeoForge and Minecraft 26.3

Fabric versions:

- Fixed AppleSkin's tooltips not showing up in the JEI sidebar
- Added support for Configured as a mod config screen provider
- Fixed Mod Menu config button showing up when no supported config screen mod (Cloth Config or Configured) is installed

NeoForge versions:

- Fixed server crash from a client joining without the mod if the mod was installed on the server (this was a regression that started in 1.20.5; the mod has always been intended to be fully optional on both sides)
- Added new translations from the latest Fabric version of the mod

This release is only for Fabric and Minecraft 1.20.1, since that version still sees use and has some stuff worth fixing. Changes:

- Backported fix for hunger/saturation info not showing up in the JEI sidebar
- Added new translations from the latest Fabric version of the mod

- Fix possible crash when max health/max hunger is changing (https://github.com/squeek502/AppleSkin/issues/308)
- NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21 version only:
  + Fix `FoodValuesEvent` being erroneously fired twice for the same tooltip values (https://github.com/squeek502/AppleSkin/issues/316)
  + Internally use NeoForge's `getFoodProperties` function (https://github.com/squeek502/AppleSkin/issues/316)

- Added v3.0.6 for Fabric/NeoForge and Minecraft 1.21/1.21.3
  + *[1.21 Fabric version only]* Fixed AppleSkin tooltips not showing up in the JEI side pane (#326)
  + Note: The 1.21 version works for 1.21 and 1.21.1 only; the 1.21.3 version is needed for 1.21.3

---

- AppleSkin versions for Minecraft 1.20.5 also works for Minecraft 1.20.6
- For Minecraft versions older than 1.20.5, see [v2.5.1](https://github.com/squeek502/AppleSkin/releases/tag/v2.5.1)
- AppleSkin will only support [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/) and [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/) from now on; there will be no Forge version for 1.20.5 or any future Minecraft versions

- Fix handling of the `HIDE_TOOLTIP` component
  + Fabric version: fixes a crash when an ItemStack had both the `HIDE_TOOLTIP` component and the `FOOD` component (#302)
  + NeoForge version: fixes the food value tooltip being drawn for ItemStacks with the `HIDE_TOOLTIP` component

> Notes:
> - AppleSkin v3.0.2/v3.0.3 for Minecraft 1.20.5 also works for Minecraft 1.20.6
> - The NeoForge version requires NeoForge >= 20.5.14-beta
